'''September 2000 Seattle tournament (16 September)''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held at Broken Games, Seattle, WA on 16 September 2000. [[Joe Olson]] won it. It is known from Keith Watabayashi's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1233">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-09-16-seattle-wa-9-16-00d1233/ seattle-wa-9-16-00], DeckTech (Keith "Gen" Watabayashi, 16 September 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-09-16-seattle-wa-9-16-00d1233/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 16 September 2000
* '''Site:''' Broken Games, Seattle, WA
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Death Star II]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Joe Olson]]
